process.title: From shelf review to reliable replenishment
process.subtitle: OM Distribution visits your business, identifies what the display needs, prepares and delivers the order, then organizes and replenishes the products.
process.ctaDescription: Tell us what your supermarket, mini market, or neighborhood store needs and we'll coordinate the next step.

1.title: We review the display
1.description: We assess the products, their condition, and the availability needed at your business.
1.alt: OM representative checking product availability in a mini market

2.title: We prepare the order
2.description: We organize the requested merchandise according to the needs identified onsite.
2.alt: Cases of merchandise prepared inside the OM delivery van

3.title: We deliver the merchandise
3.description: Our truck takes the confirmed order directly to your business.
3.alt: OM merchandise delivered by hand truck inside a supermarket

4.title: We organize and replenish
4.description: We arrange the display, replace old or expired products, and replenish inventory to maintain availability.
4.alt: Worker organizing and replenishing a mini market display
